prompt.en: Which city in Saskatchewan does Discover Canada call the headquarters of the mining industry?
prompt.fr: Selon Découvrir le Canada, quelle ville de la Saskatchewan est le siège de l'industrie minière?

explanation.en: Saskatoon, the largest city in Saskatchewan, is the headquarters of the mining industry. Regina is the provincial capital.
explanation.fr: Saskatoon, la plus grande ville de la Saskatchewan, est le siège de l'industrie minière. Regina est la capitale de la province.

source.quote: Saskatoon, the largest city, is the headquarters of the mining industry and an important educational, research and technology centre.

verification.evidence: Saskatoon, the largest city, is the headquarters of the mining industry
